_comment: Published-to-web CSV links for the Google Sheet 'CSE-Degree-Checking-Rules' (in the shared drive 'CSE Department Adminstration: Graduate Programs' since 2026-09-21; named CSE-Degree-Audit-Rules until 2026-09-05 — the published links are unchanged by a rename, and unchanged by moving the file between Drive locations: the file id, the published /d/e/ token and the tab gids all survive a move). Re-publish and update here if the sheet is ever replaced. 'external' is the published-CSV link of the ExternalCourses tab (courses from other universities the DGS has ruled on); leave it "" until that tab exists and is published — the app then treats every external course as not yet reviewed. 'universities' (2026-10-10) is the Universities tab — one row per university with its credit_system, which was a cell on every ExternalCourses row until then; the whole document is published, so a new tab's link is the same address with its own gid.
